panels.title: Broadcast Progress (30 sec) ❗All other interactions will be disabled during the broadcast
panels.description: Elapsed share of active chat (``FIRESIDE_CHAT_DURATION_SECONDS`` = 30s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN u.fireside_busy_until IS NOT NULL AND NOW() < u.fireside_busy_until THEN
      LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision,
        100.0 * (30::double precision - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (u.fireside_busy_until - NOW()))) / 30.0))
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS broadcast_progress
FROM users u
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND u.id = '$user_id'::uuid

panels.title: Cooldown (2 min)
panels.description: Time toward next Fireside start after ``last_fireside_chat_at`` (120s). Zero while broadcasting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN u.fireside_busy_until IS NOT NULL AND NOW() < u.fireside_busy_until THEN 0::double precision
    WHEN s.last_fireside_chat_at IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
    WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.last_fireside_chat_at)) >= 120::double precision THEN 0::double precision
    ELSE LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision,
      100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.last_fireside_chat_at)) / 120.0))
    END AS cooldown_progress
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN bunker_social_state s ON s.user_id = u.id
WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND u.id = '$user_id'::uuid

panels.title: Movie screen
panels.description: Single Postgres channel per player: **idle** rows use ``SOCIAL_MOVIE_PIXEL_IDLE_HEATMAP_MOVIE_ID`` (noise); **screening** rows use that title's ``movie_id`` (PNG sequence, ``movie_pixel_frame_index`` on ``bunker_social_state``). Grafana COALESCE picks which key to read. Greys scheme in panel options. Hidden ``social_movie_heatmap_history_seconds`` (900).

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
  SELECT timestamp, cells::jsonb AS ja
  FROM social_movie_pixel_samples
  WHERE '$user_id' <> '' AND user_id = '$user_id'::uuid
    AND movie_id = COALESCE(
      (SELECT movie_screening_movie_id FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1),
      '__idle_noise__'
    )
    AND timestamp <= NOW()
    AND timestamp >= NOW() - (($social_movie_heatmap_history_seconds)::double precision * INTERVAL '1 second')
),
strip AS (
  SELECT ir.timestamp,
         (r.ord - 1)::int AS row_idx,
         (r.cell_val #>> '{}')::double precision AS val
  FROM in_range ir
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ir.ja) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(cell_val, ord)
)
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 0) AS "0",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 1) AS "1",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 2) AS "2",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 3) AS "3",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 4) AS "4",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 5) AS "5",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 6) AS "6",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 7) AS "7",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 8) AS "8",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 9) AS "9",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 10) AS "10",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 11) AS "11",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 12) AS "12",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 13) AS "13",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 14) AS "14",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 15) AS "15",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 16) AS "16",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 17) AS "17",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 18) AS "18",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 19) AS "19",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 20) AS "20",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 21) AS "21",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 22) AS "22",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 23) AS "23",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 24) AS "24",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 25) AS "25",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 26) AS "26",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 27) AS "27",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 28) AS "28",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 29) AS "29",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 30) AS "30",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 31) AS "31",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 32) AS "32",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 33) AS "33",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 34) AS "34",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 35) AS "35",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 36) AS "36",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 37) AS "37",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 38) AS "38",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 39) AS "39",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 40) AS "40",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 41) AS "41",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 42) AS "42",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 43) AS "43",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 44) AS "44",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 45) AS "45",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 46) AS "46",
         MAX(val) FILTER (WHERE row_idx = 47) AS "47"
FROM strip
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp

options.content: The Atomic Cafe

panels.description: Screening progress (percent full when complete). MOVIE_SCREENING_DURATION_SECONDS in app/constants.py (60s).
panels.title: Screening progress

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT movie_screening_movie_id FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1) = 'atomic_cafe'
         AND (SELECT movie_screening_started_at FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL
    THEN LEAST(100::double precision,
      GREATEST(0::double precision,
        100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
          NOW() - (SELECT movie_screening_started_at FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1)
        )) / 60.0))
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS screening_progress
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.description: Fatigue for this title after a screening completes (+MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_GAIN_PER_PLAY per completion, same for all movies); decays per MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_DECAY_PER_SECOND.
panels.title: Exhaustion

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  LEAST(100::double precision, COALESCE(
    (SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'),
    0::double precision
  )) AS exhaustion
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Boredom Reduction
panels.description: Next screening boredom relief: boredom_relief_base from MOVIES, scaled by screenings_completed and exhaustion (same formula as game_tick).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  (
    (11.0::double precision / (1.0 + 0.45::double precision * COALESCE((SELECT screenings_completed FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))
    * (100.0 - LEAST(100.0, COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))
    / 100.0
  ) AS reduction
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

    * (100.0 - LEAST(100.0, COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0)::double precision))

panels.title: Loyalty Reduction
panels.description: Share of movie-exhaustion loyalty drain when combined exhaustion ≥ 50. MOVIE_EXHAUSTION_LOYALTY_DRAIN_PER_SECOND_AT_FULL=0.06/s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision) < 50::double precision
    THEN 0::double precision
    ELSE
      (
        (LEAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision), 100::double precision) - 50::double precision)
        / 50.0 * 0.06::double precision
      )
      * (
          COALESCE((SELECT exhaustion FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid AND movie_id = 'atomic_cafe'), 0::double precision)
          / NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(exhaustion) FROM player_movie_exhaustion WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid), 0::double precision), 0::double precision)
        )
  END AS loyalty_reduction
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: # Actors
panels.description: Theater actors (bunker_professions theater line).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT bp.count FROM bunker_theatre_systems bts
     INNER JOIN bunker_professions bp ON bp.id = bts.profession_line_id
     WHERE bts.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1),
    0
  )::double precision AS actors
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: planning / rehearsing / showing from /socials/action-status (theatre_status_ui); mirrors THEATRE_PHASE_*.

options.content: —

panels.description: Current theater phase progress. Writing/rehearsing/showing cadence uses THEATRE_*_SECONDS (60s each) in app/constants.py.
panels.title: Progress

targets.rawSql:
WITH ts AS (
  SELECT phase, phase_entered_at, next_performance_at
  FROM bunker_theatre_systems
  WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ts) THEN 0::double precision
    WHEN (SELECT phase FROM ts) = 'idle' THEN 0::double precision
    WHEN (SELECT phase FROM ts) IN ('writing', 'rehearsing')
      THEN LEAST(100.0, GREATEST(0.0,
        100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (SELECT phase_entered_at FROM ts)) / 60.0))
    WHEN (SELECT phase FROM ts) = 'ready' THEN LEAST(100.0, GREATEST(0.0,
      100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (SELECT phase_entered_at FROM ts))
      / NULLIF(GREATEST(1.0, COALESCE(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT next_performance_at FROM ts) - (SELECT phase_entered_at FROM ts)),
        60.0)), 0)))
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS phase_progress
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Loyalty gain (per sec)
panels.description: THEATRE_LOYALTY_PER_SECOND while phase is writing, rehearsing, or ready (requires energy for progression). Idle→0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT phase FROM bunker_theatre_systems WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1), 'idle') IN ('writing', 'rehearsing', 'ready')
    THEN 0.12::double precision
    ELSE 0::double precision
  END AS loyalty_per_second
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Energy use (per sec)
panels.description: Theater draw: THEATRE_POWER_DRAW_PER_ACTOR × actor count whenever actors are assigned (continuous while production runs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  (0.003::double precision * COALESCE(
    (SELECT bp.count FROM bunker_theatre_systems bts
     INNER JOIN bunker_professions bp ON bp.id = bts.profession_line_id
     WHERE bts.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1),
    0
  )::double precision) AS theatre_energy_draw_ps
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: Boredom reduction (per play)
panels.description: THEATRE_BOREDOM_RELIEF_PER_PLAY (= relief/sec × performance interval).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time, 15.0::double precision AS boredom_relief_per_play
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

options.content:
Mandatory weaving policy
Everyone attends — raise hours for more covert sales income; loyalty gain per tick is higher when hours stay low.
Hours per person—

panels.title: Mandatory hrs/person
panels.description: Stored on bunker_social_state.basket_weaving_hours (0–4).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  LEAST(4, GREATEST(0, COALESCE((SELECT basket_weaving_hours FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1), 0)))::double precision AS hours
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: BW loyalty (per sec)
panels.description: Population-independent loyalty from basket weaving (see BASKET_WEAVING_LOYALTY_PER_SECOND).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  (
    CASE LEAST(4, GREATEST(0, COALESCE((SELECT basket_weaving_hours FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1), 0)))
      WHEN 0 THEN 0::double precision
      WHEN 1 THEN 0.09::double precision
      WHEN 2 THEN 0.065::double precision
      WHEN 3 THEN 0.045::double precision
      WHEN 4 THEN 0.028::double precision
      ELSE 0::double precision
    END
  ) AS loyalty_per_second
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''

panels.title: BW cash (per sec)
panels.description: Total inner_circle_cash rate = population × per-person rate by hours (BASKET_WEAVING_CASH_PER_PERSON_PER_SECOND).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time,
  (
    COALESCE((SELECT bp.count FROM bunker_population bp WHERE bp.user_id = '$user_id'::uuid ORDER BY bp.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), 0)::double precision
    *
    (
      CASE LEAST(4, GREATEST(0, COALESCE((SELECT basket_weaving_hours FROM bunker_social_state WHERE user_id = '$user_id'::uuid LIMIT 1), 0)))
        WHEN 0 THEN 0::double precision
        WHEN 1 THEN 0.001::double precision
        WHEN 2 THEN 0.002::double precision
        WHEN 3 THEN 0.003::double precision
        WHEN 4 THEN 0.004::double precision
        ELSE 0::double precision
      END
    )
  ) AS cash_per_second
WHERE '$user_id' <> ''
